personalInfo.name: Bhargavi Govardhanam
personalInfo.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
personalInfo.summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 11+ years architecting production systems across healthcare, fintech, and enterprise domains. I bridge the gap between complex business requirements and robust, scalable software—from leading micro-frontend architectures at Fortune 500 clients to developing award-winning healthcare applications. My recent work focuses on building intelligent interfaces and modern web platforms that serve millions.

experience.description: Architecting a core Angular 17 application with micro-frontends for senior living healthcare. Reduced bundle sizes by 40% through code splitting and lazy loading. Implemented intelligent caregiver matching features, improving placement accuracy by 35%.

Sole developer of DiaFriend (10,000+ downloads on Google Play Store), a Flutter-based diabetes management tool recognized by UMass News. Revamped university library portal using React 18 and GraphQL. Conducted ML research on predictive algorithms for my Master's thesis.

Built secure fintech onboarding flows handling $50M+ in cross-border payments. Implemented React & TypeScript frontend with 99.9% uptime. Ensured PCI-DSS compliance and data integrity for high-stakes financial transactions.

Delivered a Loan Origination module processing 10,000+ daily transactions using Vue.js and Spring Boot. Owned the complete UI architecture for high-traffic processing systems serving major Indian banks.

Built HIPAA-compliant portals for AstraZeneca serving 500,000+ healthcare professionals. Developed high-volume e-commerce modules for Walmart handling millions of daily transactions. Led frontend modernization initiatives across 3 enterprise clients.

education.degree: Master of Science - MS, Computer Science
education.description: Thesis: Predictive algorithms using ARIMA and LSTM models. Developed tools for community health research. Created DiaFriend app as part of nursing research collaboration.
Foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
